name: Aqua Voice
traction_evidence: Backed by $500,000 in funding across two rounds from institutional investors Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund, the startup currently employs five people and generates approximately $450,000 in revenue. | It serves professionals, especially developers and technical users, by providing real-time, highly accurate transcription that integrates deep contextual understanding from the user’s screen and application environment.
ai_evidence: Aqua Voice: AI-powered voice dictation software for Mac and Windows, converting speech to formatted text with 99.1% accuracy in real time. | Founded in 2023 by Finnian Brown and Jack McIntire, San Francisco-based Aqua Voice develops AI-powered voice dictation software for Mac and Windows operating systems.
